today.submitCredentialsHint: Without a verified business identity, the organisation is not public.
today.inReview: Your credentials are being reviewed. You do not need to do anything.
today.inReviewHint: We check the UID in the public register by hand.
today.rejected: The credentials were rejected. The organisation is not public.
today.noLocationHint: Locations show opening hours and the providers on site.
today.openInvitationsHint: A link only becomes active once the provider agrees.
today.notPublished: The organisation is not public yet.

profile.title: Business profile
profile.intro: These details appear on the organisation’s public page once the credentials are approved.
profile.publishedHint: Changes to the profile appear on the public page right away.
profile.notPublishedHint: The organisation becomes public when the platform approves the credentials.
profile.noPermission: Your role can only view the profile. Owners, marketing and editors can edit it.
profile.name: Name
profile.nameHint: The organisation’s name on the platform, 2 to 80 characters.
profile.descriptionHint: What makes the organisation special. No addresses.
profile.publicEmailHint: Publicly visible. Do not use your sign-in address.

credentials.title: Credentials
credentials.intro: The platform verifies the business identity before the organisation becomes public.
credentials.openHint: You cannot change the details during the review.
credentials.howRegister: We compare the company name and UID with the public commercial register.
credentials.howNoDocuments: We do not store ID documents or any documents, only the details in this form and our decision.
credentials.howChanges: If the company name, UID or permits change, submit the details again. An approved organisation stays visible until the decision.
credentials.noPermission: The owner of the organisation submits the credentials.
credentials.legalName: Company name as in the commercial register
credentials.legalNameHint: Exactly as in the commercial register, with legal form, for example «Nachtwerk Zürich GmbH».
credentials.uidHint: Business identification number in the format CHE-123.456.789.
credentials.authorityConfirmed: I am authorised to act on behalf of this organisation.
credentials.authorityConfirmedHint: For example as owner, managing director or with a power of attorney.
credentials.permitNoteHint: If your canton or municipality requires a permit: which one and issued by whom, in words. Do not upload documents.

locations.title: Locations
locations.intro: Each location has its own opening hours, contact details and providers. Only a general place is given, never an address.
locations.addDescription: You set opening hours and exceptions afterwards on the location’s page.
locations.noPermission: Your role can only view locations. Owners and location managers can edit them.
locations.emptyDescription: Create the first location so that opening hours appear on the organisation’s page.
locations.emptyReadOnly: Owners and location managers create locations.
locations.openDays: {count, plural, one {Open on # day} other {Open on # days}}
locations.providerCount: {count, plural, =0 {No providers} one {# provider} other {# providers}}

fields.name: Location name
fields.descriptionHint: What guests should know about this location. No address.
fields.regionNone: No region approved yet. You can add it later.
fields.areaLabelHint: For example «District 4». Never a street or house number.

locations.detailIntro: Details, opening hours and exceptions of this location. Each section has its own save button.
locations.hoursHint: Several time slots per day are possible. Across midnight, split the time: Friday until 23:59, Saturday from 00:00.
locations.exceptionsHint: Public holidays, holidays or special nights: closed or different hours on a specific day.
locations.providersHint: Providers assigned to this location. You only see their public profile details.
locations.providersEmpty: No provider is assigned to this location yet.
locations.deleteHint: Deletes the location with all opening hours and exceptions.
locations.deleteDescription: Opening hours and exceptions are lost and cannot be restored. Linked providers stay linked, just without a location.
locations.deleteFailed: The location was not deleted. Please try again.

hours.overlap: This time slot overlaps another one on the same day.
hours.failed: The opening hours were not saved. Your entries are still here.

exceptions.removeDescription: The normal opening hours then apply again on this day.
exceptions.removeFailed: The exception was not removed. Please try again.
exceptions.dayHint: As DD.MM.YYYY. A new exception for the same day replaces the old one.

invite.title: Invite provider
invite.description: The provider sees the invitation in their studio. You are only linked once they agree.
invite.providerHint: For example «lena-zh» or the copied address of their profile.
invite.messageHint: Briefly, what it is about. The provider sees it with the invitation.

errors.slug: Enter a profile name such as «lena-zh» or a profile URL with /p/.
errors.providerUnavailable: There is no public provider profile with this name.
errors.alreadyLinked: This provider is already invited or linked.

providers.title: Providers
providers.intro: Providers linked to the organisation or who have received an invitation.
providers.privacy: You only see public profile details. Messages, ID data and private calendars of providers are never accessible to organisations. Either side can end a link; the provider’s account remains.
providers.noPermission: Your role cannot invite providers. Owners and location managers can.
providers.emptyDescription: Invite a provider using their profile name.
providers.emptyReadOnly: Owners and location managers send invitations.
providers.caption: Linked and invited providers
providers.endDescription: The provider will no longer appear on the organisation’s page. Their account and profile remain. A new link needs a new invitation and their consent.
providers.endFailed: That did not work. The link still exists.

media.title: Media
media.intro: Logo, cover photo and gallery of the organisation. Every image is reviewed before it appears publicly.
media.noPermission: Your role can only view media. Owners, marketing and editors can edit them.

settings.title: Settings
settings.kindHint: Support changes the type and address on request.
settings.teamLater: Inviting staff and assigning roles comes with the Team area in phase 2.
settings.contactHint: Contact details apply to the whole organisation. A location can have its own phone number and website.
settings.notificationsLater: Notification settings come with the notifications module. Until then, the platform sends no emails about invitations or reviews of the organisation.

admin.title: Organisations
admin.intro: Submitted credentials of clubs and agencies, oldest first. An organisation only becomes public with your approval.
admin.restricted: This area is for moderation, trust & safety and platform administration.
admin.count: {count, plural, =0 {No open reviews} one {# open review} other {# open reviews}}
admin.caption: Submitted credentials

empty.title: No open reviews
empty.description: As soon as an organisation submits its credentials, it appears here.

facts.legalName: Company name as in the commercial register
facts.authorityYes: Yes, the acting person confirmed it
facts.name: Name on the platform

admin.registerHint: Compare the company name and UID in the federal public UID register. There are no documents.

decision.title: Decision

optionHint.CHANGES_REQUESTED: The organisation sees your reason and submits again.
optionHint.REJECTED: The organisation is suspended and not public. It sees your reason.

decision.reasonHint: At least 10 characters. For «Request correction» and «Reject» the organisation sees it; it is recorded in the audit log.

errors.reasonTooShort: The reason needs at least 10 characters.
errors.alreadyDecided: This review has already been decided.
errors.generic: That did not work. Please try again.
errors.forbidden: Your role may not decide here.
